name: Change
overview: Scripture acknowledges that change is an inherent part of life, as seen in Ecclesiastes 3:1 which teaches that there is a season and a time for every purpose under heaven. Believers are encouraged to face change with courage and confidence, trusting that the Lord is with them and will not forsake them (Deuteronomy 31:6; Joshua 1:9). Wisdom and knowledge are essential in navigating change rightly, as Proverbs 18:15 and 19:2 remind us that a prudent heart seeks understanding and that acting without knowledge leads to sin. Ultimately, God’s plans for His people are good and purposeful, offering hope and a future amid life’s changes (Jeremiah 29:11).
